correctness.rationale: Renewal first-flip identity gives exact stationary orientation-correlation transform; exponential-filter double integral yields exact variance. Strict convex Jensen and explicit two-point approximants prove both sharp envelopes and strict convex-order monotonicity. High-k dominated-convergence limits and Laplace uniqueness recover speed, mean and duration distribution; second-order Laplace expansion gives weak trap coefficient, periodic phase gives uniform limit. Independently derived reversal-epoch moment/reward formula agreed on 48 parameter configurations, and 12 exact-interval event-driven integrations matched within 0.4%. Proof is analytic and does not extrapolate finite data.

originality.rationale: The closest full-text Farago–Smith paper analyzes the identical non-Markovian run-time physical framework with a nonlinear potential and density integral equations, but not the evaluated exact harmonic variance plus all-stiffness infinite-dimensional minimax, inverse stiffness spectroscopy with unknown speed/mean, or weak-trap singularity. Strongest competing harmonic literature assumes exponential Markov runs or active reservoirs. Public research-record alternatives concern slit-wall renewal diffusivity or unequal alternating sojourn aliasing and do not imply this combined theorem. Baseline renewal and filter identities are prior mathematical tools. Broader published generalization remains a declared residual risk.
residual_risks: Unknown general theorem for stationary renewal telegraph noise under linear filtering might explicitly establish the same all-stiffness minimax and inverse identification; available searches do not certify global publication priority.
Extending model from waiting-time densities to strictly positive atomic durations uses classical renewal construction; the source paper primarily treats waiting-time densities.
Spectroscopic inversion is idealized, requiring noiseless stationary variance as a function of every positive stiffness; severe statistical ill-conditioning is possible.
Comparison with the two public mathematical research records used their recoverable exact claims, not complete source full text; this was not treated as full-text not-covering evidence.

value.rationale: For a physical non-Markovian active particle, the variance scan defines an injective inverse observable; exact mean-preserving stochastic-order bounds identify global minimum and strict unattained supremum without arbitrarily slicing parameters. The weak-trap variance undergoes a sharp finite-vs-inverse-stiffness singular transition at exactly deterministic reversals, with an explicit noise coefficient. This is a motivated structural comparison rather than an elementary normalization check, and useful for quantifying how timing variability changes confinement and for theoretical switching-law identification.
